name: build_sprite_control_pair
description: Computes the start and stop control words for a pair of hardware sprite entries from an object's screen X and Y position and the current frame index, then stores them in the sprite buffer. It then walks the linked object list, calling per-object update routines for each record that overlaps the screen area.

name: load_object_speed_from_table
description: Stores a value taken from a 16-bit lookup table, indexed by a register, into an object field. When the index is 18 it also flips the object's direction field, then advances the shared frame counter modulo 10.

name: load_object_offset_from_table
description: Stores a value taken from a second 16-bit lookup table, indexed by a register, into an object field. When the index is 18 it also flips the object's direction field, then advances the shared frame counter modulo 10.

name: find_object_at_point_animate
description: Walks a linked list of nine-word object records to find the first record whose rectangle contains the given point. It then loads that record's motion field from one of three lookup tables chosen by the sign of its direction value, flips the direction at index 18, and advances the frame counter.

name: copy_indexed_longword_pair
description: Copies two longwords from a table entry selected by the object's index field into fixed state longwords, then calls a follow-up routine.

name: blend_masked_bitplanes
description: Combines four source bitplane words, each shifted right by a count held in a register, with a 32-bit mask from the object state and the two destination planes using AND and OR. It writes the result into four destination planes over sixteen iterations, each stepping through the planes by a fixed stride.

name: copy_startup_block_then_loop
description: Copies five longwords from a source block into the low memory area, records two pointer values in globals, and calls four setup routines. It then loops forever, calling four routines on each pass.

name: init_scroll_table_and_delay
description: Fills a block of 16-bit table entries with fixed values and busy-waits through a nested counted loop. It then optionally offsets several entries by a scroll value and fills a row-offset table in steps of 256.

name: copy_table_row_to_destination
description: Copies twelve words from a row of a table into a destination table. The row is picked from the stored index in the state record, shifted right by two and multiplied by a 48-byte row length.

name: set_bitplane_pointers
description: Reads a base address and writes its high and low words into the four bitplane pointer slots, spacing the planes 8000 bytes apart. Each value is also mirrored into two further copies of the pointer table.

name: copy_and_repack_bitplanes
description: Copies a block of 768 longwords, then runs eight passes that clear the start of each output row. For each column it combines four input plane words with AND-NOT and OR operations and writes the results into a row-interleaved output.

name: service_audio_channel_flags
description: Checks a shared status word for pending requests on the four audio channels and clears the busy flag. For each request not already busy, it sets that channel's bit in the status word and clears the request.

name: claim_audio_channel_slot
description: Picks an unused channel record from a small array, stores the requested sample's start address and length there, and records the audio enable value. It skips the search when the mode field is 2, or 1 with request kind 0 or 4.

name: start_ready_audio_channels
description: For each of the four audio channel records that is marked active and matches the current sequence value, copies its sample address, length and period into the channel's hardware registers. It then sets the channel volume to the maximum level, marks the record done, and enables the DMA bit.

name: load_dos_file_into_buffer
description: Opens a DOS file and retries the open while it fails, then reads in a loop until the read returns a non-negative count. It closes the file and releases the library base, and returns failure if the first call gives no result.

name: read_dos_file_with_retries
description: Opens a DOS file through the library and retries the open while it fails. It then reads with a retry loop until the read succeeds, and closes the file and releases the library base.

name: write_block_to_dos_file
description: Opens a DOS file handle, and if that succeeds writes a block of data to it and returns the count written. On any failure it fetches the DOS error code, closes the handle, releases the library and returns an error marker.

name: open_dos_library_base
description: Opens the DOS library through the exec library's OldOpenLibrary call and stores the returned library base in a global.

name: report_dos_error_and_close
description: Reads the DOS error code, closes the file handle, releases the library base, and returns a failure marker.

name: examine_dos_file_info
description: Opens a file, examines it through the DOS library, and stores the returned information word in a global when the examine call succeeds. Otherwise it closes the handle, releases the library and returns failure.

name: translate_keyboard_scancode
description: Decodes a raw keyboard code read from the keyboard serial register. Key presses are mapped through a character table for codes below 80, with a shift offset applied while the shift state is active, and key releases only update that shift state.

name: update_shift_key_state
description: Resets the shift-state flag when the low seven bits of the key code are 96 or 97, the two shift key codes, and returns its input unchanged.

name: install_custom_copper_list
description: Opens the graphics library, saves its current copper list pointer and replaces it with the program's own copper list. It then writes DMA and interrupt enable words and closes the library.

name: restore_system_copper_state
description: Disables the DMA channels and interrupt sources by writing clear masks, restores the previously saved copper list pointers, and then turns the DMA channels back on.

name: verify_longword_table_or_halt
description: Compares five longwords of one table against a second block of five longwords. It enters an endless loop when any pair differs, so the program stalls rather than continue after a mismatch.

name: check_longword_block_or_halt
description: Compares five longwords of one table against a second block of five longwords. It enters an endless loop when any pair differs, so the program stalls rather than continue after a mismatch.

name: service_copper_and_vblank_interrupts
description: Handles the copper interrupt by recording a status code and clearing its request. It then handles the vertical blank interrupt by advancing a frame counter, updating a ring buffer entry and recording a timing word from the input status.

name: service_vertical_blank_step
description: Runs the vertical blank part of the interrupt work when the request bit is set. It advances a frame counter, pushes a handler pointer into a 32-entry ring buffer and records a timing word built from the object at offset 10.

name: update_mouse_button_state
description: Combines two mouse button flags into a two-bit button state value. It then stores the change in a position word as a movement delta for the object.

name: update_pointer_position_from_mouse
description: Turns the change in a mouse counter since the previous call into a signed step. It adds that step to the horizontal and vertical position words and clamps them to the screen limits, with the horizontal range 0 to 344 and the vertical range 0 to 248.

name: refresh_pointer_from_mouse_counters
description: Takes the change in the mouse counters since the previous call as a signed step. It adds that step to the pointer position words and clamps them to the screen limits, with the horizontal range 0 to 344 and the vertical range 0 to 248.

name: apply_mouse_delta_to_pointer
description: Turns the change in the mouse counters since the previous call into a signed step. It adds that step to the pointer position words and clamps them to the screen limits, with the horizontal range 0 to 344 and the vertical range 0 to 248.

name: set_pointer_position_with_delta
description: Stores a new horizontal position and adds a vertical delta to the vertical position word. The delta is corrected by 255 when the input exceeds 127, and both positions are then clamped to the screen limits.

name: update_pointer_from_joy0_counter
description: Reads the mouse counter from the joystick zero data register and computes its signed change against the previously stored value. It adds that change to the vertical position and applies the screen limits.

name: store_pointer_counter_and_clamp
description: Stores a counter value as the new horizontal position word and adds a corrected vertical delta. It then clamps the vertical result to the range 0 to 248.

name: clamp_pointer_screen_bounds
description: Clamps a vertical position word between a stored lower bound and 183. It also clamps the horizontal position word to 304 once it exceeds 303.

name: re_enable_task_switching
description: Calls the exec Permit routine to re-enable task switching and returns the input registers unchanged.

name: disable_task_switching
description: Calls the exec Forbid routine to disable task switching and returns the input registers unchanged.

name: swap_pair_and_wait_interrupt
description: Swaps two longwords in the object record and sets a flag word to 1. It then busy-waits until the vertical blank request bit is set, calls a follow-up routine and writes the interrupt enable word.

name: wait_for_vblank_then_enable
description: Busy-waits until the vertical blank request bit is set, then writes the interrupt enable word with its set bit.

name: parse_ascii_header_fields
description: Compares a marker in the data with the buffer and, when it matches, decodes the ASCII decimal digits that follow it into numeric globals. When the marker does not match, it calls a library routine, resets, and transfers control to the low memory restart point.

name: parse_header_timing_fields
description: Compares a marker in the data with the buffer and, when it matches, decodes the ASCII decimal digits that follow it into numeric globals, storing a subset of the timing and pointer fields. On a mismatch it calls a library routine, resets, and transfers control to the low memory restart point.

name: parse_header_pointer_fields
description: Compares a marker in the data with the buffer and, when it matches, decodes the ASCII decimal digits that follow it into numeric globals, storing a subset of the pointer fields. On a mismatch it calls a library routine, resets, and transfers control to the low memory restart point.

name: parse_header_numeric_fields
description: Compares a marker in the data with the buffer and, when it matches, decodes the ASCII decimal digits that follow it into numeric globals, storing a subset of the numeric fields. On a mismatch it calls a library routine, resets, and transfers control to the low memory restart point.

name: match_banner_and_parse_fields
description: Checks the buffer for the credit banner text, DIGITAL PERSUASION, and when it matches decodes the numeric fields after it into globals. It clears a counter and a table index on success, and on mismatch calls a library routine and resets.

name: drain_key_event_ring
description: Takes the next code from a 32-entry ring buffer when the read index differs from the write index, then advances the index with wrap-around. When the code is 97 and a flag is clear, it calls a library routine and resets.

name: poll_key_event_ring
description: Takes the next code from a 32-entry ring buffer when the read index differs from the write index, then advances the index with wrap-around. When the code is 97 and a flag is clear, it calls a library routine and resets.

name: store_longword_in_state
description: Stores the longword passed on the stack into a fixed field of the state record.

name: reset_and_jump_low_memory
description: Calls the reset routine and then transfers control to the low memory address 2, which is the program's fixed restart point.

name: dispatch_exec_or_reset
description: Compares a stored count with 35. When the count is higher it calls an exec library routine at offset -726. Otherwise it calls a library routine, resets, and jumps through a dispatch table entry.

name: open_library_then_reset
description: Calls a library routine at offset -30, then resets and jumps through a dispatch table entry.

name: reset_and_dispatch_entry
description: Calls the reset routine and then jumps through a dispatch table entry located from the program's data.

name: load_plane_addresses_from_view
description: Opens the graphics library, reads the first bitmap plane pointer from the view structure, and derives the other plane addresses at 8000-byte spacing. It stores them in globals and then closes the library.

name: reload_plane_base_addresses
description: Opens the graphics library, reads the bitmap pointers from the view structure, and derives the plane base addresses at 8000-byte spacing. It stores them in globals and then closes the library.

name: reload_plane_offset_table
description: Opens the graphics library, reads the bitmap pointers from the view structure, and derives the plane offsets at 8000-byte spacing. It stores them in a table of globals and then closes the library.

name: reload_plane_pointer_pair
description: Opens the graphics library, reads the bitmap pointers from the view structure, and derives a pair of plane addresses at 8000-byte spacing. It stores them in globals and then closes the library.

name: reload_plane_stride_offsets
description: Opens the graphics library, reads the bitmap pointers from the view structure, and derives the plane stride offsets from the 8000-byte plane size. It stores them in globals and then closes the library.

name: reload_plane_stride_pair
description: Opens the graphics library, reads the bitmap pointers from the view structure, and derives a stride pair from the 8000-byte plane size. It stores them in globals and then closes the library.

name: reload_plane_end_offsets
description: Opens the graphics library, reads the bitmap pointers from the view structure, and derives the end offsets of each plane at 8000-byte spacing. It stores them in globals and then closes the library.

name: open_graphics_and_setup_planes
description: Opens the graphics library through the exec OldOpenLibrary call and derives the bitplane addresses from the view structure's bitmap pointers at 8000-byte spacing. It then closes the library and returns the input registers unchanged.

name: initialise_level_state_tables
description: Clears the game state fields to zero or to sentinel values and zeroes the counters of 32 records. It then fills several longword tables with a start value and walks the linked list of entries for the current level.

name: decompress_lzss_stream
description: Unpacks an LZSS-style compressed stream. It first clears a 4096-byte window with spaces, then reads flag bytes that select either a literal byte or a back-reference copied from the window, writing each output byte to the destination and to the window.

name: copy_block_into_four_planes
description: Copies a block of 4000 words into four bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart. It then walks a list of entries, calling one of two routines per entry depending on a sign flag, and finally dispatches a last call through a table.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: Empty routine that returns immediately without any work.

name: draw_object_list_by_type
description: Walks an object list, converting each object's screen coordinates into a cell position. It then dispatches each object to a per-type drawing handler through a jump table until the list ends.

name: pack_pixels_into_bitplanes
description: Converts a run of source bytes into bit values using a lookup table and merges them into four bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart. It advances 40 bytes per row for the given count.

name: pack_row_into_bitplanes
description: Converts a row of source bytes into bit values using a lookup table and merges them into four bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart. It advances 40 bytes per row for the given count.

name: update_timer_accumulators_by_mode
description: Resets the timer accumulators and limits when the mode is zero. Otherwise it adds the scaled counters into the accumulators at a rate of 6000 for mode 1 and 3000 for other modes, then sets the matching limits and step.

name: run_frame_sequence_until_limit
description: Runs a per-frame loop of several update and draw calls, marking the state record as active. The sequence ends once a frame counter exceeds 124.

name: restart_state_sequence_if_ready
description: When the state counter is at least 3 it runs the update calls, marks the state as ready and resets the counter. Otherwise it returns immediately.

name: run_state_update_sequence
description: Runs the state update calls, sets the state flags and resets the state counter.

name: compute_grid_cell_from_position
description: Derives a grid cell index by dividing an object's position offset by a rate when the position lies within bounds. It then stores the cell values and marks the cell valid.

name: run_frame_state_machine
description: Runs the frame state machine: it processes pending request flags in turn and updates the scroll and position state. When a copy request is pending, it copies the four bitplane buffers into the display planes and sets the redraw flag.

name: copy_object_and_wrap_position
description: Copies position and display fields from one object record to another and clears a flag. It then wraps the object's two coordinates into a 375-unit cycle using the supplied offsets.

name: wrap_object_position_modulo
description: Wraps the object's two position words into a 375-unit cycle relative to the supplied offsets.

name: clear_status_text_cells
description: Writes space characters into a block of cells at fixed row offsets within the text buffer.

name: compose_hud_status_text
description: Builds a status text line in a buffer by copying name strings with a colon separator, then appending the literals Kts and a slash. It writes either War or Civ followed by a two-digit number built from tens and units.

name: store_signed_index_pair
description: Stores the value in one field. When it is negative it also stores it in a second field and returns, otherwise it calls a routine and stores the result in the second field.

name: scan_render_list_for_position
description: Initialises a list entry from the input offset, then repeatedly reads entries from the list and compares each position with the object's position. It returns once the scan reaches the end or a boundary.

name: store_and_swap_index_pair
description: Stores a new value in one field and moves the previously stored value into a second field. It marks the second field invalid when the two values match.

name: scan_render_list_mode_three
description: Initialises a list entry from the input offset with mode three, then reads entries from the list and compares each position with the object's position. It returns once the scan reaches the end or a boundary.

name: advance_masked_counter_loop
description: Repeats a pair of calls for a count held in a register, advancing a 15-bit counter by one on each pass. The first pass clamps the counter to four.

name: forward_single_call
description: Calls a single routine and returns, with no other work.

name: store_byte_in_indexed_table
description: Stores the low byte of an input value into a table entry chosen by doubling the value and offsetting it from a base table. It then calls a follow-up routine.

name: compose_status_name_line
description: Fills two text rows with spaces and an attribute byte, then copies name strings from the object's string table into them. A colon separates the strings in the first row when a flag is clear.

name: format_three_digit_decimal
description: Writes an input number as three ASCII digits, replacing leading zeros with a blank glyph.

name: format_three_digits_zero_padded
description: Writes an input number as three zero-padded ASCII digits.

name: format_two_digit_zero_padded
description: Writes an input number as two zero-padded ASCII digits.

name: format_four_digit_decimal
description: Writes an input number as four ASCII digits, replacing leading zeros with a blank glyph.

name: copy_planes_into_frame_buffer
description: Resets two state fields and copies a 4000-word block from four plane buffers into the destination bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart. It then calls several display routines.

name: build_spread_and_gray_tables
description: Fills a 256-entry table with bit-spread words built from each byte value, and a 512-entry table with Gray-code words. It then calls a follow-up routine.

name: clear_text_block_with_spaces
description: Fills a block of longwords with the space pattern, using 64 entries or 51 depending on a mode flag. It writes a second row of entries 64 longwords ahead.

name: clear_text_block_from_pointer
description: Fills a block of longwords with the space pattern, using 64 entries or 51 depending on a mode flag. It writes a second row of entries 64 longwords ahead, starting from the pointer passed in.

name: write_packed_text_entries
description: Reads entries from a packed table until a negative marker. Each entry gives a row and column byte and a zero-terminated string, and the characters are written into the text buffer with the entry's attribute byte.

name: render_text_cells_four_passes
description: Runs four passes over a grid of text cells, drawing each cell's glyph into four bitplanes with a colour mask chosen by the pass number. It waits on the frame counter between passes and returns once the state flags allow.

name: init_timer_pointers_and_accumulate
description: Sets two buffer pointers in the state record, then resets the timer accumulators and limits when the mode is zero. Otherwise it adds scaled counters into the accumulators at a rate of 6000 for mode 1 and 3000 otherwise.

name: render_text_string_to_planes
description: Renders each character of a zero-terminated string into four bitplanes using 8-byte glyph bitmaps from the font. Spaces produce blank cells.

name: spin_wait_on_counter_offset
description: Busy-loops while the sum of the input and the stored counter differs from the stored counter, so it returns only when the input is zero.

name: draw_text_rows_to_planes
description: Optionally stores a position pair and calls a routine, then renders each character of a text list into the four bitplanes using the font. Spaces produce blank cells.

name: copy_text_block_to_display
description: Sets a scroll position, then copies a 32-longword header block and a 1840-longword block between two buffers. It calls several routines around the copy.

name: render_indexed_text_string
description: Looks up a text string in a table using a row index from the state record, then renders each character into the four bitplanes from the font. Spaces produce blank cells.

name: run_object_update_frame_loop
description: Runs a loop that records the frame counter, copies the pending state into the object's fields and calls a set of update routines on each pass. It adjusts the object's flags as it goes until the loop completes.

name: blit_object_into_planes
description: Blits an object's image into four bitplanes, combining masked source words with the destination planes over several rows. It calls helper routines to select the source and to clip the object to the screen.

name: merge_planes_under_mask
description: Merges three source bitplanes into the destination planes over six rows of ten words. The fourth plane acts as a mask, so source bits are OR-ed in only where the mask is set.

name: draw_text_masked_to_planes
description: Renders a zero-terminated string into the bitplanes using the font, combining each glyph row with the existing plane contents through a colour mask.

name: blit_rotated_object_sprite
description: Computes a sprite angle for the object, wrapped at 360, and blits its shape data into the bitplanes at the computed screen position. The sub-pixel phase sets the bit shift.

name: update_object_draw_list
description: Walks the object list and computes a scaled size for each object, clamped to a minimum of 1. It then calls the drawing routines for each entry.

name: draw_object_entries_loop
description: Loops over an entry list, calling a drawing routine with the fields of each entry. It updates the entry's current value and clears its slot marker when the value changes.

name: clip_rectangle_to_screen
description: Checks a rectangle against the screen edges and returns a failure value when it lies fully outside. Otherwise it marks the clipped rows in the clip table.

name: update_visible_object_entries
description: Walks the object entries, updating each entry's screen position and rate counters. It draws the entries that fall inside the view.

name: scale_value_by_fraction
description: When the input field is nonzero, scales a stored value by the difference from 64 divided by 64. It stores the scaled result and the remainder.

name: compute_scaled_sprite_size
description: Derives scaled sprite dimensions by dividing a 10-bit fixed-point size by a divisor. It stores the width and height and returns early when a size is too small.

name: compute_scaled_sprite_rect
description: Checks a sprite's visibility flags and link index, then derives a scaled size from its table entry and stores the result. It returns early when the scaled height is zero.

name: compute_flagged_sprite_size
description: Derives a scaled sprite size from the table entry when the 1024 flag bit is set, then stores the position and dimensions. It returns early on a zero scale.

name: draw_sprite_entry_list
description: Walks a list of sprite entries, computing each entry's position from its stored offsets. It calls the sprite draw routines for entries within range.

name: clip_sprite_rectangle_to_view
description: Checks a sprite rectangle against the view edges, with a horizontal limit of 320 and a vertical limit of 102. It returns a failure value when the sprite lies outside, and otherwise marks the clipped rows.

name: advance_animation_counter_table
description: Decrements an animation counter and, when it runs out, reloads it from a frame-timing table and advances the table index. The index wraps to the start at the end of the table.

name: clear_sprite_cell_planes
description: Clears a block of bitplane bytes for a sprite cell, writing zero to three planes and 255 to the first plane. It repeats across the rows given by the object's table.

name: run_routine_with_flag_once
description: Sets the state record's flags, calls a routine once and marks a byte in the state record before returning.

name: draw_status_panel_planes
description: Draws a fixed-layout panel into the four bitplanes. It fills the block with a background pattern, writes glyph rows from the panel data and calls helper routines for each row.

name: walk_entry_list_and_mark
description: Walks a list of entries from the state record and skips entries that do not match the current position. It marks the matching entries and calls their routines until the list ends or a limit is reached.

name: test_tile_within_bounds
description: Checks an offset pair against bounds that depend on the row, then computes a tile index and reads its entry from the map table. It returns the result to the caller.

name: setup_blitter_masked_copy
description: Writes a sequence of blitter-related words into the state record, then calls a wait routine and writes the DMA enable word. It sets up a masked copy of one row block.

name: setup_blitter_row_copy
description: Writes a sequence of blitter-related words into the state record, then calls a wait routine and writes the DMA enable word. It sets up a row copy of two blocks.

name: program_blitter_row_copy
description: Programs the blitter registers for a masked row copy, waits for the blitter to finish, and then re-enables the DMA bit. The source and destination pointers are taken from the input registers.

name: program_blitter_plane_pairs
description: Programs the blitter registers for a masked copy of two plane pairs, advancing the source and destination by 8000 bytes between passes. It waits for the blitter to finish after each pass and re-enables the DMA bit.

name: reset_blitter_state_and_wait
description: Clears two state fields, writes the interrupt mask value and calls two routines to wait for the blitter. It then writes the enable word and clears a flag.

name: increment_state_counter
description: Adds one to a 16-bit counter in the state record and returns the input registers unchanged.

name: poll_input_and_update_state
description: Reads the fire button and the right and middle button inputs and records their state in the state record. It then increments the frame counter and calls three helper routines to update the input state.

name: update_sprite_state_per_frame
description: Records the current animation value and clears a pending state marker when it is set. It then advances the per-frame sprite state through two routines.

name: update_sprite_state_on_zero
description: When the zero flag is set, it marks a pending clear or processes the object's table entry. Otherwise it calls the state routines.

name: update_sprite_state_negative
description: Stores the state value. When the value is negative it marks the state invalid, otherwise it processes the object's table entry through two routines.

name: process_sprite_entry_when_clear
description: When the flag is clear, processes the object's table entry by calling routines and comparing a scaled value with the stored limit before updating the state.

name: assign_free_sprite_slots
description: Sets the slot counter and walks seven sprite slot entries. Each free slot, marked by the value -1, receives the current position and a computed address into the object table.

name: compute_object_screen_position
description: Derives screen X and Y values for an object by scaling a table entry with a shifted value. It stores both results in the output words.

name: claim_free_position_record
description: Scans records of seven words until it finds one that is free, marked by the value -1. It then stores the current position and a computed screen value in that record.

name: store_object_screen_size
description: Stores the object's scaled screen X with an offset of 80 and its Y with a lower clamp of 0 in the state record. It derives both values from the object's position.

name: store_scaled_screen_position
description: Stores the scaled screen X with an offset of 80 and the Y with a lower clamp of 0 and an offset of 3. It then builds a sprite control word pair from those values.

name: write_sprite_control_words
description: Writes two input words into a sprite control buffer, choosing the second buffer when the flag is set. It then builds and stores the control words from the object's scaled position.

name: select_and_run_wait_routine
description: Selects a wait routine based on the state flags, calls it, and clears the state field.

name: advance_sprite_state_machine
description: Advances a sprite state machine: the state value selects a branch that updates position fields and calls helper routines. State 8 resets the handler slot before the helpers run.

name: find_rect_containing_point
description: Scans a list of rectangle records for the first one whose bounds contain the input X and Y, and stops at that match.

name: test_object_rect_hit
description: When the state is 4 and the object is above the limit of 176, tests whether its rectangle overlaps a fixed hit area. On overlap it calls the helper routines.

name: dispatch_handler_by_index
description: Clears the handler field and calls a routine chosen from a jump table by the input index. It then records the input parameters in the state record and returns the fourth parameter.

name: draw_sprite_frame_from_state
description: Draws the current sprite frame when the sprite is active, choosing its source buffer and draw mode from the state record. It calls the blit routines to place the frame.

name: run_state_handlers_by_index
description: Calls the handler selected by the sprite state from a jump table, running it twice when the state is 5 or higher. When the state is 4 and the object is above the limit, it also tests the object's rectangle against a hit area.

name: run_state_handler_hit_test
description: Calls the handler selected by the state from a jump table. When the state is 4 and the object is above the limit, it then tests the object's rectangle against a hit area.

name: advance_state_or_reset
description: Resets the state to zero when the input is 8, otherwise advances it by one. It then clears the interrupt flag and records the input parameters in the state record.

name: increment_sprite_state_and_store
description: Advances the sprite state by one, clears a flag and records the input parameters in the state record.

name: test_rect_and_set_state
description: When the object is above the limit of 176, tests its rectangle against a hit area. On overlap it sets the state record fields to the hit values.

name: set_hit_state_from_rect
description: Tests the object's rectangle against a fixed hit area. On overlap it sets the state record fields to the hit values, then records the parameters.

name: mark_flag_and_advance_state
description: Sets a flag to one, advances the state by one, clears a flag and records the input parameters in the state record.

name: test_rect_and_set_hit
description: Tests the object's rectangle against a fixed hit area, and on overlap records the hit values in the state record. The state is then advanced and the parameters are stored.

name: find_entry_containing_rect
description: Scans table entries and returns the first one whose bounds contain the input rectangle. It checks each entry's flag before comparing the bounds.

name: store_pointer_value_and_advance
description: Copies a word from the input pointer into the state record, sets a flag and advances the state by one. It then records the input parameters.

name: copy_plane_block_rows
description: Copies an eight-row block of longwords from the source plane area to the destination. Each row is copied across four planes spaced 8000 bytes apart.

name: dispatch_index_with_zero_check
description: Returns when the input is zero. Otherwise it calls a routine from a jump table, using a separate table entry for indices 12 and 24.

name: dispatch_table_with_special_index
description: Calls a routine from a jump table, using a separate table entry when the input is 12 or 24.

name: call_fixed_table_slot
description: Calls the routine at a fixed slot in a jump table and returns.

name: call_table_entry_by_index
description: Calls the routine at the jump table offset given by the input value and returns.

name: call_slot_from_state_table
description: Calls a routine from a jump table selected by a field in the state record. It passes the sum of a stored offset and the object's position.

name: call_slot_from_object_pointer
description: Calls a routine from a jump table selected by a field in the record that the state record points to. It passes the sum of that record's offset and the object's position.

name: draw_sprite_frame_by_mode
description: Draws the sprite frame for the current mode, updating the frame buffer pointers and selecting the source frame from the record. It then calls the blit routines.

name: copy_name_until_colon
description: Copies characters from an input string into a buffer until a colon or the length limit is reached. It then terminates the buffer and looks up the matching entry in a table.

name: step_cycle_index_with_wrap
description: When the object is active, adds the step value to a cycling index that wraps to zero above four. It stores the index in the object record and updates the display entry.

name: step_cycle_index_and_draw
description: When the object is active, adds the step value to a cycling index that wraps to zero above four. It stores the index in the object record and updates the display entry.

name: toggle_flag_and_store
description: When the object is active, toggles a flag byte in the object record. When its position field is negative, it stores the current position and sets the state.

name: repeat_call_twenty_then_finish
description: Clears the active flag and calls a routine twenty times. It then restores the flag and calls three more routines.

name: call_three_routines_return
description: Calls three routines in sequence and returns the input value unchanged.

name: call_two_routines_return
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns the input value unchanged.

name: call_routine_then_return
description: Calls one routine and returns the input value unchanged.

name: call_relay_stub_return
description: Calls one routine and returns the input value unchanged.

name: call_stub_return_value
description: Calls one routine and returns the input value unchanged.

name: call_stub_chain_return
description: Calls one routine and returns the input value unchanged.

name: call_routine_keeping_registers
description: Calls one routine and returns the D0 and D1 register values unchanged.

name: swap_state_word_around_call
description: Saves the state longword, replaces it with the value from the second input register for one call, then restores the saved value. It returns the input registers.

name: dispatch_jump_table_by_register
description: Calls a routine from a jump table selected by the scaled value in the index register.

name: toggle_flag_and_draw_entry
description: When the object is active, toggles a flag byte in the object record. When its position field is negative, it stores the current position and sets the state before drawing.

name: select_label_string_by_flag
description: Looks up a label string from a table based on an object flag, then copies it into the output buffer character by character.

name: measure_and_copy_label_text
description: Measures a zero-terminated string from a fixed table, then copies its characters into the output buffer from the end backwards.

name: copy_reversed_string_suffix
description: Skips leading spaces in a string and measures the remainder. It writes the fixed M suffix and a terminator, then copies the characters into the output buffer from the end backwards.

name: copy_label_glyphs_reversed
description: Measures a zero-terminated string and writes its characters from the end backwards. Each character is converted to an 8-byte glyph offset in a font table.

name: step_cycle_index_for_label
description: When the object is active, updates a cycling index that wraps to zero above four and stores it in the object record. It then updates the display entry.

name: format_stop_status_text
description: Chooses between the STOP label and a numeric status text based on a mode byte, then copies the selected text into the output buffer.

name: format_full_or_marker_text
description: Selects the FULL label when the input is 4. Otherwise it writes two marker characters and uses the object's label, then copies the chosen text into the output buffer.

name: write_marker_then_label
description: Writes two marker characters and a terminator to the output buffer, then copies the object's label text into it from the end backwards.

name: format_signed_value_text
description: Formats an input value as text, writing a dash for zero and otherwise converting the absolute value with a terminator.

name: copy_label_glyphs_terminated
description: Writes a terminator, measures the label string, then writes its glyph offsets into the output buffer from the end backwards.

name: format_offset_value_text
description: When the object is active it calls a routine first. It then formats the absolute value of its offset field as text, writing a dash when the value is zero.

name: format_offset_value_with_flag
description: When the object is active and its two state values differ, it calls a routine first. It then formats the absolute value of its offset field as text, writing a dash when the value is zero.

name: format_offset_value_reset
description: Clears the state flag, then formats the absolute value of the object's offset field as text, writing a dash when the value is zero.

name: format_offset_value_by_slot
description: When the object is active it calls a routine first. It then formats the absolute value of its offset field as text, writing a dash when the value is zero.

name: test_flag_mask_and_act
description: Tests a flag word in the object record against a mask. When the flag is set it runs one of the routines, chosen by the object's stored state.

name: xor_pixel_bits_into_plane
description: Updates a plane byte by OR-ing and XOR-ing bit patterns computed from the input offset. It writes several bytes of the bitplane row.

name: write_bitplane_words_with_clip
description: Writes a set of longword and byte updates into the bitplane rows at offsets from the input value. Values that fall outside the valid range are clipped.

name: format_decimal_up_to_three
description: Writes an input value as decimal digits with leading zeros suppressed. It uses one digit below ten, two digits below one hundred and three digits otherwise.

name: format_one_or_two_digits
description: Writes an input value as decimal digits, using two digits when the value is above nine.

name: copy_label_glyphs_offsets
description: Measures a string and writes its glyph offsets into the output buffer from the end backwards.

name: sum_label_glyph_offsets
description: Writes the glyph offsets of a string into the buffer from the end backwards while accumulating a running total of their values.

name: shift_glyph_rows_into_planes
description: Walks a null-terminated list of glyph pointers and shifts each glyph's bytes into the bitplane rows by the computed bit offset. The result is OR-ed into the destination planes.
